name: ALERTWest
description: Ingests ALERTWest camera locations, orientation and latest imagery from the public ALERTWest camera API and registers each camera site as a Core Device.

permissions.description: ALERTWest creates a Core Device for every camera site
ALERTWest looks up the Device previously created for a site when its cache has no record of it
ALERTWest updates each site Device with the latest camera status, orientation and imagery

schedule.description: Polls the public ALERTWest camera API for the full camera list on a schedule - defaults to every 5 minutes.
